subject: Your phone sounds new after 28 days
preview_text: A month in, here's what your audio journey looks like. One tap changed everything.
body_paragraphs: You've been using Volume Booster for four weeks now. That's 28 days of hearing what your speakers were hiding. Remember the first time you tapped that boost button and your playlist exploded out of the phone? That was just the beginning.

Here's what you've already unlocked without even thinking about it: every podcast you've listened to without cranking the volume to max, every song that finally had a bass line you could feel, every Netflix scene that didn't sound like it was recorded through a pillow. That's momentum. And it's real.

But here's the part most people miss after a month—the equalizer presets. You've been boosting, but have you tried the Jazz preset on a quiet track? Or the Rock preset on a live recording? It's like getting a new pair of headphones for free. The app's been tracking your most-used settings, and it's ready to suggest a custom EQ curve that matches your taste perfectly.

Open the app today and tap the equalizer icon. Let it scan your listening history and hit 'Apply Suggested Preset.' It takes 10 seconds. P.S. The bass booster combined with the Electronic preset on a track like 'Strobe' by Deadmau5 will make your phone feel like a club speaker. Try it once, and you'll never go back.
